title: Cantonese Beef Toast
description: A Chinese-inspired dish featuring tender beef and crispy toast, served with a sweet and savory sauce.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together light soy sauce, hoisin sauce, olive oil, ginger, and garlic. Add the sliced beef and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
3. Remove the beef from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
4. Brush both sides of the toast with olive oil and toast in the oven for 2-3 minutes, or until crispy.
5. In a large skillet or wok, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat. Add the marinated beef and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired level of doneness.
6. Assemble the dish by placing a slice of toasted bread on each plate, topping with a few slices of beef, and garnishing with scallions and sesame seeds (if using).
